story-context.title: Locale Architecture: Wire the Registry
story-context.overview:
Wire the existing ref.Country + config.ValidationRule + config.PromptTemplate(Version) + config.PromptAssemblyProfile registry into the form-AI service so that locale-aware prompt blocks render at request time from data, not from Python string constants. Add audienceLocale and brandPosture API parameters with a default-resolution chain (request -> Event.CountryID -> Company.CountryID -> User.CountryID -> app_setting). Replace rubric_v1 with rubric_v2 (9-element scoring; 6 deterministic + 3 LLM-judged). Replace prompts-v1.0 with prompts-v1.1 (15 x 6 x 3 = 270 cells). Swap Gemini judge for Grok 4; pin Claude 4.7. Re-judge baseline as the gate to proceed.
This story is wiring an existing registry, not building greenfield. ~70% of the data layer is already built and seeded.

critical-objectives.item: Render-at-request-time from existing registry; preserve forward-compatibility to tool-use Option C.
Format/policy/tone sub-block split is the architectural axis — keep it strict.
Brand posture is a separate parameter from audience locale (Memo 4) — do not collapse.
Resolution chain must be deterministic and tested at every fallback step.
Tonyk's lived-AU calibration anchors are embedded in rubric_v2 — they are ground truth, not advisory.
AC-10 escape clause exists if all three judges still ceiling-lock under v2 + nudge — story is not blocked indefinitely.
NEUTRAL fallback is by design (info-level log, not error) when audience_locale is unknown.

constraints.item: Do NOT modify the closeout amendment after PR #74 merges; any further amendment goes in a new commit on master.
Do NOT cross-compare rubric_v1 and rubric_v2 scores anywhere (per v1 ADR baseline-re-snapshot policy).
Do NOT add Gemini back to the judge panel — Grok 4 replaces it; the panel is Claude 4.7 + Grok 4 + GPT-5 mini.
Do NOT introduce a new dependency for caching (process-local dict + monotonic clock is sufficient for the 5-minute cache).
Do NOT redesign UI for audienceLocale/brandPosture in this story — defaults-only pass-through; per-form override is a future story.
Do NOT skip pre-review of NZ/UK/US/CA/IE/INTL_ONLINE locale blocks — Tonyk Q5: pre-reviewed quality is required for all 7 MVP markets.
Do NOT block the architecture work on AC-10 ceiling-lock — escape clause is a real path; register the carry-forward and proceed.
Do NOT bump capability snapshot version unless renderer manifests change (none should in this story).
Do NOT touch frontend AI panel beyond pass-through plumbing for the new params.

invariants.item: Capability Snapshot Rule: no renderer manifest changes in this story, so no capability snapshot bump.
Multi-Round UAT Protocol: AC-10 calibration round is multi-round-eligible; one variable per round (rubric anchor sharpening); RequestID lineage required.
Green CI/CD Rule: full backend pytest + frontend lint/unit gates must demonstrably pass before closeout.
Database Connection Consistency Rule: all migrations applied via standard alembic flow; preflight captures both DATABASE_URL and resolved URL.
